deliveredMessage.subject: Re: For Westford families: a free guide to sensory-friendly and adaptive outings
deliveredMessage.editorRequest: Editor asked for Westford-only article or event/venue idea in reply to original November 2 outreach.
deliveredMessage.exactBody:
Hi Kathleen,

Thank you for such a thoughtful reply. You’re right: a general New England calendar link isn’t a Westford story.

A more useful angle for Westford readers might be a short, practical local service piece: what families should ask before choosing an inclusive or sensory-aware activity in town. For example, WestfordCAT’s calendar lists a “Lunch Bunch” program at We Rock the Spectrum in Westford beginning December 1, subject to sufficient enrollment. Rather than repeat the event listing, the piece could explain how families check age eligibility, cost, registration, quiet-break options and the support available before they make the trip.

I would verify the current program details with the organizer, distinguish confirmed accommodations from questions still to ask, and keep the focus on Westford families—not promote An AUsome Life or imply I have personally tested the program.

Would that be closer to the kind of reader-service piece The Westford Villager could consider? I’m happy to shape a locally reported draft for editorial review if it fits.

Thank you again for being so welcoming.

Warmly,
JoHannah Ash
An AUsome Life
hello@anausomelife.com
